sentences.en: Your artless attempt at a treatise is more like a diatribe.
sentences.zh: 你那篇未经雕琢的论文更像是抨击文章。

sentences.en: The definitive treatise was written by someone with no formal education in the subject.
sentences.zh: 这部权威性的专著是由一位没有正式受过该学科教育的人撰写的。

sentences.en: Tom's "treatise" was little more than a racist diatribe.
sentences.zh: 汤姆的‘论文’不过是一篇种族主义的抨击文章罢了。
